content.json:
# Tribal Kava conversion dashboard
Order, directions, call, VIP, events, and drink-finder activity from the live site. Local preview traffic is excluded.

content.title: Conversion actions
content.query:
let live = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com';
datatable(Action:string, Sort:int, EventName:string)[
'Order online', 1, 'order_online',
'Directions', 2, 'directions',
'Phone calls', 3, 'phone_call',
'VIP texts', 4, 'vip_sms',
'VIP emails', 5, 'vip_email',
'Event interest', 6, 'event_interest',
'Event inquiries', 7, 'event_inquiry',
'Drink recommendations', 8, 'drink_recommendation'
]
| join kind=leftouter (live | summarize Actions=count(), People=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by EventName=name) on EventName
| project Action, Actions=coalesce(Actions, 0), People=coalesce(People, 0), Sessions=coalesce(Sessions, 0), Sort
| order by Sort asc
| project-away Sort

content.title: Visits and high-intent actions over time
High-intent path by session
Campaigns producing action
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where name in ('order_online', 'directions', 'phone_call', 'vip_sms', 'vip_email', 'event_interest', 'event_inquiry', 'drink_recommendation')
| extend Source=tostring(customDimensions.campaign_source), Medium=tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium), Campaign=tostring(customDimensions.campaign_name)
| summarize Actions=count(), People=dcount(user_Id), Orders=countif(name == 'order_online'), Directions=countif(name == 'directions'), Calls=countif(name == 'phone_call') by Source, Medium, Campaign
| order by Actions desc

content.title: What the drink finder recommends
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where name == 'drink_recommendation'
| extend Drink=tostring(customDimensions.recommended_item), Base=tostring(customDimensions.botanical), Flavor=tostring(customDimensions.flavor), Moment=tostring(customDimensions.vibe)
| summarize Recommendations=count(), People=dcount(user_Id) by Drink, Base, Flavor, Moment
| order by Recommendations desc
